mission.title: Firepower
mission.description: Help the General's commandos scan the Exiles, guard his coders, and collect the enhanced weapon codes.

npc.say: Sir! Diodorus is in charge here, sir!
Good work, soldier! I'll be sure to put your name in for a commendation!
Our compiler's highly efficient. I wrote it myself.
We've finished compiling that code, despite all your racket. The General will want to talk to you.
I'm glad that's over with. I never want to see a dire lupine subroutine again.
Piece of cake, as you people say.
Use them strategically, soldier, and the codes on that disk will polish off a whole platoon of those beasts in no time.

phase.briefing:
Warrior, the General's liaison officer has notified us that while they have made progress on their enhanced Exile-killing weapons, thanks to the data you helped retrieve earlier, their database is still incomplete; they need to scan data from at least one more type of Exile.
They have provided more commandos with enhanced combat scanning routines for this purpose. Pick them up at the location indicated.

enter.say: At the rate you go through these commandos, I wonder if the General is going to have any left when it actually comes time for a major offensive?

talk.say: Scanning routines up and running, sir.

objective.text: Lead Craven and Warren out of the area

phase.briefing: You've scanned dire lupines already, so this time we're sending you after a different species of the Merovingian's Exiles. The commandos will scan critical data as you fight them.

enter.say: Exiles ahoy! Man the decks and prepare for boarding!

done.say: Good. I'm told that the General's group is receiving a data feed on those Exiles. Head outside so we can check in with Tyndall.
Got some great data, sir! I'm sending it to intel now.
Thank you, sir. The data is uploading now.

phase.briefing:
You're doing well, operative. The General's coders have the data they need to begin writing the enhanced anti-Exile weapons.
Since this is such an important initiative in our struggle against the Merovingian, the Zion Council has decided that we should provide additional security for the General's lab while they work on the codes. As you've worked with the General's programs extensively, you're a natural choice for this vital task. Proceed to the lab, coordinate with their security team, and make sure that the coders are not disturbed in their work.

enter.say: The lab is in there. Looks clear of any Exiles or redpills so far.

talk.say: Good to have you here, soldier. So far everythi-- What?! Red alert! We've got incoming hostiles!

done.say: I've got bogeys incoming... Exiles! Protect those coders!
We'll have to use a quaternion scheme for that function...
Can't you keep the noise down to a dull roar? We've got code to compile here!
Garbage code coming to retrieve their garbage, huh? Cute.

objective.text: Do not let the coders die

done.say: Area scans clean now. Man, that was--whoops! Tyndall's pinging me. Head outside and I'll splice you into her line.

phase.briefing: The General wants to meet with you, Warrior. I'm told that thanks to your security efforts, his coders completed the anti-Exile weapons, and the General wishes to present them to you personally. He has them on a computer disk.

enter.say: The General's in there, all right. I hope you're wearing your Sunday best.

objective.text: Get the disk of weapon codes from The General

talk.say: You've done a hell of a job, soldier. Thanks to the data you helped my men gather, and the protection you gave my coders, we've got those enhanced weapons that will put the Merovingian's Exile programs on the run like the dogs they are. I'm proud to be able to hand your allotment of weapon codes to you personally.
Get that disk of weapon codes from him, man. You're gonna need a free slot in your inventory.
Collect the codes for your weapon from me, soldier. You've earned them.

done.say: Okay. Get out of there. By the way, if you've got anyone else on your mission team, make sure they have a free inventory slot, too.

mission.finish:
Warrior, you can take that disk to the "Zion Researcher" in your district and have them compile it into weapons for you.
The General's weapons have the appearance of familiar tools used against Exiles: holy water, wooden stakes, and silver bullets. But these "enhanced" weapons of his should do a significantly higher amount of damage to Exile programs than the standard consumable items. They are in limited supply, but I know you will use yours wisely. Once all of our operatives are equipped with such weapons, the Merovingian will surely have to surrender in the face of our superior firepower.
